Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 4, 2026

Ingatik helps you study and remember, and the recordings, notes, and progress you create along the way are yours. This policy explains what we collect, why, and how to get it removed.

1. Information we collect

  • Account data: your email, display name, and handle when you create an account.
  • Study data: your sessions, streaks, XP, subject tags, voice-note recordings, and the AI-generated summaries and checklists made from them.
  • Usage data: anonymized product analytics (PostHog, Google Analytics) and crash reports (Sentry) so we can fix bugs and improve the app.
  • Purchase data: subscription status via RevenueCat and the App Store / Google Play. We never see your card details.

2. How we use information

  • To run the core loop: timers, recaps, summaries, leaderboards, and streaks
  • To process your voice notes into summaries and next-task checklists
  • To process subscriptions and keep your Pro entitlements in sync
  • To understand product usage and improve the app
  • To respond to support requests

Voice recordings are processed to generate your summary and are not used to train AI models or shared with other Whizzes. Leaderboards only show your display name, handle, hours, XP, and streak.

3. Third parties

We rely on Supabase (data storage & auth), RevenueCat (subscriptions), PostHog and Google Analytics (analytics), and Sentry (crash reporting). Each processes only the data needed for its job.

4. Data retention & deletion

Your data is kept while your account is active. You can delete your account and all associated data at any time from our account deletion page; deletion is permanent and completes within 30 days.

5. Contact

Questions about this policy? Email privacy@ingatikrecall.com.
